# Irving Rivera

> Managing Software Engineer leading enterprise modernization and payments teams, who still builds software himself.

Irving Rivera is a Managing Software Engineer with 10+ years building software for large financial and insurance companies, based in Carrollton, Texas. At Allstate he leads geographically dispersed Agile teams on legacy modernization and payments work, splitting his time evenly between hands-on architecture and engineering direction. He manages and mentors developers, including performance management, calibration, and goal setting, and leads AI adoption across the team. Outside his day job he builds independent projects and client sites end to end. Earlier roles include State Farm, Premier Trailer Leasing, and federal agency consulting work.

## Enterprise work — Allstate, Managing Software Engineer, Claims Technology Services (2020–present)

- Leads geographically dispersed Agile teams; 50% hands-on architecture, 50% engineering direction.
- Manages and mentors developers: performance management, calibration, and goal setting.
- Modernizing legacy VB.NET claims systems onto Java and Spring Boot.
- Pay.gov payment processing and reconciliation, including validation and audit controls that prevent duplicate payments and meet regulatory requirements.
- Claims payment transactions processed through Kafka consumers using the Saga pattern, with compensating steps on failure.
- Leads production incident investigations and root-cause analysis for payment failures.
- Moved payment KPI monitoring from Splunk to Fabric and Power BI, consolidating 21 Splunk searches into KQL and DAX with rolling thresholds.

## Featured projects

- AI Job Agent (built solo, end to end): an AI-powered job search assistant. Finds matching roles, vets each one, tailors resumes and cover letters, and hands the user a direct application link. The AI does the judgment work, but code makes the final call: hard scoring caps, company website checks, per-user spending limits, and human approval at each step. Node/Express/Prisma backend on PostgreSQL, React frontend, Clerk auth, Stripe billing, Claude API. Live at https://job-agent-production-76b5.up.railway.app
- Sonobe (client project): marketing site for a custom furniture studio in Ciudad Juárez/El Paso, built and shipped as sole engineer. Runs in English and Spanish. https://sonobedi.com
- Holey Donuts (client project): marketing and ordering site for a donut shop in Denton, TX, design through deployment, including a full Korean translation. https://holeydonutsdenton.com

## Technologies

Java, Spring Boot, .NET/C#, VB.NET, Node.js, Express, React, Kafka, ServiceNow (scoped apps), Azure Data Explorer / KQL, Power BI, Oracle, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, SQL Server, AWS, GCP, CI/CD (Jenkins, Harness, GitHub, Octopus Deploy), LLM APIs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI).
